messages.content: "請問您能告訴我紐約洋基隊在2019年球季MLB的排名，然後查看洛杉磯湖人隊在2020年球季NBA的排名，最後，您能提供2020年12月25日洛杉磯和2021年1月1日紐約的空氣質量指數嗎？"

function.name: air_quality
function.description: Retrieve the air quality index for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city that you want to get the air quality index for.

date.description: The date you want to get the air quality index for. Default is today.

function.name: sports_ranking
function.description: Fetch the ranking of a specific sports team in a specific league Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

season.description: Optional parameter to specify the season, default is the current season.

message.reasoning:
The user asks three things:

1. "紐約洋基隊在2019年球季MLB的排名" -> New York Yankees 2019 MLB ranking. They want the ranking of the team in the league. So we need to call sports_ranking with team="New York Yankees", league="MLB", season=2019.

2. "洛杉磯湖人隊在2020年球季NBA的排名" -> Los Angeles Lakers 2020 NBA ranking. So sports_ranking with team="Los Angeles Lakers", league="NBA", season=2020.

3. "2020年12月25日洛杉磯和2021年1月1日紐約的空氣質量指數" -> Air quality index for Los Angeles on December 25, 2020 and New York on January 1, 2021. So two calls to air_quality: first location="Los Angeles", date="2020-12-25"; second location="New York", date="2021-01-01".

We need to output the results. We should call the functions accordingly. The user wants all three pieces of information. We'll do separate calls. The order: first sports_ranking for Yankees 2019; second sports_ranking for Lakers 2020; third air_quality for LA 2020-12-25; fourth air_quality for NY 2021-01-01.
